subject.title: feat(cli): add `agents` and `<agent> models` runtime discovery commands

question: Should core adopt the proposed `agents` and `models` command/output contract, and if so must model discovery preserve the ACP session created by `session/new`?
rationale: The repository treats flags, command names, output shapes, and persistence semantics as durable product surface; source inspection cannot decide whether this specific convention and lifecycle are intended.

options.title: Approve with managed lifecycle
options.body: Keep both commands, but require stable output documentation and preserve/manage the ACP session created for model discovery unless ACP gains a true session-free discovery capability.

options.title: Ship agent discovery only
options.body: Land the non-secret agent inventory command and defer live model discovery until its session lifecycle has an explicitly approved contract.

options.title: Keep discovery downstream
options.body: Decline the new core command surface and let downstream tools perform discovery through existing ACP integration code.

recommendation.title: Approve with managed lifecycle
recommendation.body: Keep both commands, but require stable output documentation and preserve/manage the ACP session created for model discovery unless ACP gains a true session-free discovery capability.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work spans the CLI output and session-management surfaces implicated by this decision.
